title: Has today been a blur for anyone?

classification.question_topic: Reports intense recurring Mall World dreams but memory is blocked/blurred; asks if others experienced today as a blur and implies daytime mood shift linked to Mall World.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream scenes, locations, entities, or events described; only reports of intense dreams with blocked/blurred recall and daytime affect changes.

meta.author_theory: As soon as the subconscious starts putting pieces together and trying to get you out of a 'knot,' you are 'swept back'; implies daytime state changed due to what happened in Mall World.

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to reported intensity of dreams and inability to recall them ('memory is blocked', 'all blurry'), plus a described 3–5 day waking-life mood/clarity shift. No describable Mall World locations, layouts, entities, actions, sensory details, or boundaries are provided.
